allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5173/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Output "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output $r.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(500,$r.Content.Length\)\) } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: $_" })
